issues.where: the submerged drop-off and dark water beyond the foreground ledge
issues.what: the sheer vertical underwater limestone cliff wall and the faint vertical submerged creatures in the right-hand depths are completely missing, replaced by a gentle shallow turquoise slope
issues.fix: restore the steep vertical underwater cliff drop-off descending into dark abyssal water and add the faint pale vertical forms deep below the surface on the right

issues.where: the skeleton on the foreground shore (also prominent in set-B-02.png)
issues.what: the skeleton reads as an oversized, smooth, clay-like 3D model with a featureless lump for a skull, thick uniform tube-like ribs arching too high, and blocky limb bones resting on top of the ground rather than a weathered, anatomically detailed skeleton partially buried in wet kelp
issues.fix: replace with a realistically weathered, finely detailed quadruped skeleton with proper skull anatomy, thinner irregular ribs, and organic bone texture partially embedded in the wet algae

issues.where: the foreground shoreline, rock ledge, and left-side water
issues.what: the rugged 3D craggy limestone shelf and tangled wet filamentous algae of -a are replaced by a flat, smooth spit with painted-on orange-brown streaks and a wide, bright, mirror-flat water expanse on the left
issues.fix: build real 3D rocky relief with jagged ledge edges and layered wet kelp strands draping into the water, and remove the overly bright flat water expanse on the left

issues.where: the mid-lake water surface and cliff reflections
issues.what: the wide concentric circular ripples across the center-right water are absent, and the reflections of the far cliffs are overly sharp, high-contrast, and artificially sliced into horizontal bands
issues.fix: soften the cliff reflections with subtle misty diffusion and add the delicate wide concentric ripples spreading across the calm water

issues.what: their anatomy and surface look like smooth, rubbery tapering tails or tentacles bending to pointed tips, lacking the wrinkled ringed necks, blunt rounded heads, haunch contours, mottled organic skin markings, and soft foreground bokeh of -a
issues.fix: match the thick ringed-neck anatomy and blunt heads of -a, add mottled organic skin texture with natural creases and warm rim lighting, and soften them with matching foreground depth of field

issues.where: the rising dark mound and surrounding water in the center (also prominent in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the rising back looks like a smooth matte grey-blue plastic blob without wet water-streaming detail, the pale radiating submerged structures visible beneath the surface are missing, and the concentric wake rings around the mound and small white tips are largely gone
issues.fix: add wet glistening surface ripples streaming over the rising dark mass, restore the faint radiating pale ribs/structures beneath the water, and add crisp concentric wake rings and golden glints around the mound and each breaking white tip

issues.where: the lake water across the entire frame (also prominent in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the water has a muddy warm-brown color cast and looks overly smooth and oily instead of cool slate-grey water covered in crisp, dense horizontal wind-ripples with broken bright golden cliff reflections
issues.fix: shift the water base tone to cool dark slate-grey and add fine, crisp horizontal ripple micro-detail that breaks up the warm cliff reflections naturally

issues.where: the distant caldera cliffs and far shoreline
issues.what: the background cliffs are tack-sharp with harsher contrast and thinner shoreline mist, lacking the shallow depth-of-field softness and moody atmospheric haze of -a
issues.fix: add natural lens depth-of-field blur to the distant cliffs, slightly soften sunlit highlight contrast, and thicken the low mist along the far water edge

issues.where: the distant cliff face and far shoreline
issues.what: the cliffs are overly sharp and grainy with tighter framing on the upper left and are missing the prominent dark vertical rock streaks and stains between the sunlit face and the cave
issues.fix: soften the distant cliff sharpness to match atmospheric distance, restore the dark vertical streaks/stains on the rock face, and match the softer luminous mist band along the far shore
